```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggplot2)
library (tidyverse)
library (multcomp)
#install.packages("writexl")
library (writexl)
```

```{r}

# 1. Load and prepare

df_pig <- readxl::read_excel("~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Raw_data/Field trial/Pigment_Field_Trial Final_fixed_May.xlsx") %>%
  rename(
    NBI          = `Nitrogen Balanced Index`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Month     = factor(Month, levels = c("May", "June", "July")),
    Treatment = relevel(as.factor(Treatment), ref = "Non-treated control"),
    Block     = as.factor(Block),
    Plant_ID  = as.factor(paste(Treatment, Block, Plant, sep = "_"))
  )

View(df_pig)

# Replace zeros with NA (failed readings)
df_pig <- df_pig %>%
  mutate(
    Anthocyanins = ifelse(Anthocyanins == 0, NA, Anthocyanins),
    NBI          = ifelse(NBI          == 0, NA, NBI)
  )
#2. AVERAGE 2 READINGS PER PLANT PER VISIT
# ============================================================
df_plant <- df_pig %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Month, Block, Plant, Plant_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Chlorophyll  = mean(Chlorophyll,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Flavonols    = mean(Flavonols,    na.rm = TRUE),
    Anthocyanins = mean(Anthocyanins, na.rm = TRUE),
    NBI          = mean(NBI,          na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("=== Cleaned plant-level summary ===\n")
df_plant %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(across(c(Chlorophyll, Flavonols, Anthocyanins, NBI),
                   ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE), 3)))


```

Fit models
```{r}
#3. FIT MODELS — repeated measures (same plants May→Jul)
# Fixed: Treatment * Month | Random: Block + Plant_ID
# ============================================================

# --- Chlorophyll ---
m_chl <- glmmTMB(
  Chlorophyll ~ Treatment * Month + (1|Block) + (1|Plant_ID),
  family = gaussian(), data = df_plant
)
cat("\n=== Chlorophyll model ===\n"); summary(m_chl)
res_chl <- simulateResiduals(m_chl, n=1000); plot(res_chl)

# --- Flavonols ---
m_flav <- glmmTMB(
  Flavonols ~ Treatment * Month + (1|Block) + (1|Plant_ID),
  family = gaussian(), data = df_plant
)
cat("\n=== Flavonols model ===\n"); summary(m_flav)
res_flav <- simulateResiduals(m_flav, n=1000); plot(res_flav)

# --- Anthocyanins ---
m_anth <- glmmTMB(
  Anthocyanins ~ Treatment * Month + (1|Block) + (1|Plant_ID),
  family = gaussian(), data = df_plant
)
cat("\n=== Anthocyanins model ===\n"); summary(m_anth)
res_anth <- simulateResiduals(m_anth, n=1000); plot(res_anth)

# --- NBI ---
m_nbi <- glmmTMB(
  NBI ~ Treatment * Month + (1|Block) + (1|Plant_ID),
  family = gaussian(), data = df_plant
)
cat("\n=== NBI model ===\n"); summary(m_nbi)
res_nbi <- simulateResiduals(m_nbi, n=1000); plot(res_nbi)

# If other models pass, try Gamma for NBI
m_nbi2 <- glmmTMB(
  NBI ~ Treatment * Month + (1|Block) + (1|Plant_ID),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data   = df_plant
)

res_nbi2 <- simulateResiduals(m_nbi2, n=1000); plot(res_nbi2)
plot(res_nbi2)




# ============================================================
# 4. EMMEANS — contrasts vs Non-treated control per month
# ============================================================
for(mod in list(m_chl, m_flav, m_anth, m_nbi)) {
  nm <- deparse(substitute(mod))
}

extract_contrasts <- function(model, label) {
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Treatment | Month)
  contr <- contrast(emm, method="trt.vs.ctrl",
                    ref="Non-treated control", adjust="dunnettx")
  cat(paste0("\n=== ", label, " contrasts ===\n"))
  print(summary(contr, infer=TRUE))
}

extract_contrasts(m_chl,  "Chlorophyll")
extract_contrasts(m_flav, "Flavonols")
extract_contrasts(m_anth, "Anthocyanins")
extract_contrasts(m_nbi2,  "NBI")
```
Plots
```{r}
# ============================================================
# COMBINED 2x2 PIGMENT PLOT
# ============================================================
library(patchwork)

trt_colors <- c(
  "Non-treated control"         = "gray50",
  "Copper standard"             = "#009E73",
  "Cons1 (Pb39 and Pb177)"      = "#56B4E9",
  "Pseudathrobacter sp. Pb177"  = "#CC79A7",
  "Streptomyces sp. Pb39"       = "#E69F00"
)

trt_levels <- c(
  "Non-treated control",
  "Copper standard",
  "Cons1 (Pb39 and Pb177)",
  "Pseudathrobacter sp. Pb177",
  "Streptomyces sp. Pb39"
)

# Fix cld_nbi — Gamma model returns response scale differently
# Rerun get_cld with type="response" for NBI
get_cld_response <- function(model, label) {
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Treatment | Month, type = "response")
  cld <- multcomp::cld(emm, adjust = "tukey",
                        Letters = letters, alpha = 0.05) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      .group  = trimws(.group),
      pigment = label,
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = trt_levels)
    ) %>%
    rename(
      emmean   = response,
      lower.CL = asymp.LCL,
      upper.CL = asymp.UCL
    )
  return(cld)
}

get_cld_gaussian <- function(model, label) {
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Treatment | Month)
  cld <- multcomp::cld(emm, adjust = "tukey",
                        Letters = letters, alpha = 0.05) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      .group  = trimws(.group),
      pigment = label,
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = trt_levels)
    ) %>%
    rename(
      lower.CL = asymp.LCL,
      upper.CL = asymp.UCL
    )
  return(cld)
}

cld_chl  <- get_cld_gaussian(m_chl,  "Chlorophyll")
cld_flav <- get_cld_gaussian(m_flav, "Flavonols")
cld_anth <- get_cld_gaussian(m_anth, "Anthocyanins")
cld_nbi  <- get_cld_response(m_nbi2, "NBI")

# ============================================================
# Plot function
# ============================================================
plot_pigment <- function(cld_data, y_label, y_breaks = NULL) {

  p <- ggplot(cld_data,
              aes(x = Month, y = emmean, fill = Treatment)) +

    geom_col(position  = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
             width     = 0.85,
             color     = "black",
             linewidth = 0.3) +

    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                  position  = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
                  width     = 0.2,
                  linewidth = 0.45) +

    geom_text(aes(y     = upper.CL + max(upper.CL, na.rm=TRUE) * 0.03,
                  label = .group,
                  group = Treatment),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
              size     = 3,
              fontface = "bold") +

    scale_fill_manual(values = trt_colors) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = y_breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
    ) +

    labs(x = "Month", y = y_label, fill = "Treatment") +

    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 16, face = "italic"),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      legend.position  = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}

# ============================================================
# Build 4 panels
# ============================================================
p_chl  <- plot_pigment(cld_chl,  "Chlorophyll (SCI)",
                        y_breaks = seq(0, 60, 10))

p_flav <- plot_pigment(cld_flav, "Flavonols (SCI)",
                        y_breaks = seq(0, 2.5, 0.5))

p_anth <- plot_pigment(cld_anth, "Anthocyanins (SCI)",
                        y_breaks = seq(0, 0.25, 0.05))

p_nbi  <- plot_pigment(cld_nbi,  "Nitrogen Balanced Index",
                        y_breaks = seq(0, 40, 10))

p_chl  <- plot_pigment(cld_chl,  "Chlorophyll index",   y_breaks = seq(0, 60, 10))
p_flav <- plot_pigment(cld_flav, "Flavonol index",      y_breaks = seq(0, 2.5, 0.5))
p_anth <- plot_pigment(cld_anth, "Anthocyanin index",   y_breaks = seq(0, 0.25, 0.05))
p_nbi  <- plot_pigment(cld_nbi,  "Nitrogen Balance Index", y_breaks = seq(0, 40, 10))




# ============================================================
# Combine with shared legend
# ============================================================
combined <- (p_chl + p_flav) / (p_anth + p_nbi) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
  
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40")
  )

combined

# Save
ggsave(
  filename    = "Pigments_2x2_panel.tiff",
  plot        = combined,
  path        = "~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Outputfiles/Field output files",
  width       = 14,
  height      = 10,
  dpi         = 300,
  units       = "in",
  device      = "tiff",
  compression = "lzw"
)
```
